name: Life
overview: Scripture reveals that life originates from God's breath, as He formed man from the dust and breathed into him the breath of life, making him a living soul (Genesis 2:7). Life is depicted as a precious gift connected to obedience and relationship with God, symbolized by the tree of life placed in the Garden of Eden, which offers eternal life but was guarded after man's fall to prevent access (Genesis 2:9, 3:22, 3:24). The brevity and frailty of human life are acknowledged through the reflections of patriarchs who recognize life as a temporary pilgrimage marked by frailty and mortality (Genesis 18:27, 47:9).
